“The settlement of Foundation represents the first step in the Settlers' plan to reclaim Appalachia, through building, expansion and community.”— Fallout 76 loading screens

**Foundation** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update. It is the Settler headquarters, and was built on the site of the former Spruce Knob Workshop.

A fortified settlement built on the site of a pre-War tourist attraction, Foundation is the main base of the Settlers, a group of people that came from Pittsburgh under the leadership of Paige in the hope that it would offer some reprieve from the horrors in the north. Upon their arrival, and subsequent discovery of Spruce Knob, they repurposed the existing buildings, cleared the surrounding trees and Foundation was formed. [4] Ever since, Foundation has been a haven for other Settlers in Appalachia, and an eyesore for the Raiders at the Crater. Foundation's power comes from its main Fusion Generator. [5] Ward and Paige lead the settlement, working to create a viable home in Appalachia. [3] [2] [6] 

Much of Foundation is built on wooden logs, obtained thanks to the settlement's own Mill Saw at the Builder's Nest. [7] The town contains several buildings, including a barracks, boarding house, and a variety of stores ran by the Sunnys. The Spruce Knob observation deck is located in its center. There are two instanced interior locations - Founder's Hall and Foundation Supply Room. Fast traveling to Foundation will spawn the player west of the settlement, on the road leading to the main gate. When Minerva visits Foundation, her tent will be placed along the eastern side of the main road, between the main gate and the fast travel destination.

- Elsie's story - Note, in the Taylors' home, on a kitchen counter (cannot be taken).
- Ward's journal - Note, in the medical office pod across from the Power Armor Stations (cannot be taken).
- Potential Magazine - On the east side of Foundation, at a small guard house near a gate, on a desk.
- Potential Weapon Mod - Immediately north of Foundation, next to an army Skeleton at a satellite console, inside a military vehicle, in the back row.

- Scavengers occasionally visit the settlement.
- Settler Wanderer mentions that she came to Appalachia with Paige's group, but decided against staying with them at Foundation.
- Being at the top of Spruce Knob, Foundation is the highest settlement in Appalachia.
- Around Foundation there are Raider paintings, including some of the old Raider decals and the logo of the Gourmands, Diehards, Trappers, and Blackwater Bandits. The decals are not static, and will be updated with other logos after some time. These paintings were also involved in the unused quest Daily: A Refreshing Outlook.
- None of the containers within Foundation will contain instanced loot.
- If the player character becomes a Ghoul, they will be unable to enter the Founder's Hall (and will be unable to fast travel to Foundation at all) without wearing a disguise from Jaye Vo.

- As of patch 1.3.1.26, Yao Guai and Scorched no longer spawn in the settlement.
- As of patch 1.4.0.20, fast traveling to Foundation is free of charge.

- The weather vane on the roof of the Taylors' residence is not correctly aligned to the cardinal directions, with the north indicator facing west, the east indicator facing north, the south indicator facing east, and the west indicator facing south.
- Samuel will occasionally wander from his designated position at the direction bulletin board.
- When Grahm passes through Foundation, he may become stuck inside the southside moat or underneath the overpass near the Founder's Hall.
- Scorched officers and Feral Ghoul officers may occasionally wander into Foundation.

Foundation appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update. It was built on the former location of Spruce Knob.

According to level designer Steve Massey, Foundation replaced Spruce Knob as it was previously a "pretty boring workshop location" and it was selected due to its central location within the Savage Divide. [Dev 1]
